categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily as a Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing comprehensive biopharmaceutical R&D services. Its main segments include Clinical Trial Solutions (CTS) and Clinical-Related and Laboratory Services (CRLS), covering drug clinical trials, medical device clinical services, medical registration, pharmacovigilance, medical translation, data management, statistical analysis, site management, laboratory services, and real-world studies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as decentralized clinical trials (DCT), artificial intelligence (AI), digital platforms including remote monitoring systems (CTRM), subject eligibility discussion systems (SEDS), safety report portals, and the YiYa AI Translation Platform. It employs risk-based quality management (RBQM), AI-driven clinical trial design, patient recruitment, intelligent monitoring, and AI-powered medical writing and regulatory submission tools to enhance efficiency and quality in clinical research.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include multinational pharmaceutical companies, domestic large pharmaceutical firms, innovative biotech startups, and medical device companies. The company serves clients engaged in drug and medical device R&D across various therapeutic areas such as oncology, endocrinology, metabolism, radiopharmaceuticals, cell and gene therapy, ophthalmology, and rare diseases. It supports clinical trials and regulatory submissions globally, with a focus on China, North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in China, North America (notably the U.S.), Europe, Asia-Pacific (including Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, and Australia), and emerging markets such as Africa. It has established local teams and subsidiaries across over 30 countries, with significant operations in major Chinese cities and international hubs including Hong Kong, Beijing, Shanghai, and Jiaxing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream in the biopharmaceutical R&D supply chain as a service provider facilitating drug and medical device development. It acts as an intermediary between pharmaceutical/biotech companies and clinical trial sites, providing integrated R&D services from early-stage clinical trials through regulatory approval and post-market studies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding international footprint with focus on North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific; strengthening integrated R&D service capabilities; specializing in key therapeutic areas such as endocrinology, radiopharmaceuticals, cell and gene therapy, and ophthalmology; and accelerating AI-driven digital transformation to enhance operational efficiency and innovation. The company invests in AI applications for clinical trial design, patient recruitment, data management, and medical translation, aiming to build AI-native clinical trial products and platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through fee-for-service contracts in clinical trial operations, medical device clinical services, medical registration, pharmacovigilance, data management, laboratory testing, site management, medical translation, and real-world studies. The company also derives income from strategic minority investments in innovative healthcare companies and investment funds, as well as licensing and collaboration agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading CRO in China with a 12.8% market share and is ranked among the top 10 global clinical service providers. It competes with multinational CROs and domestic small to medium-sized CROs. Its competitive advantages include extensive experience, global synchronized operations, integrated full life-cycle R&D services, high-quality standards, and a broad network of collaborations with clinical trial sites and research institutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB6.6 billion, with a slight decline from the previous year due to industry cycles and competitive pressures. It has over 10,000 employees worldwide and operates in 33 countries. Despite a challenging market environment, the company achieved 7.3% year-over-year growth in net new bookings and a 12.0% increase in backlog of future contracted revenue. The company maintains a strong financial position with total assets of RMB28.7 billion and a gearing ratio of 9.6%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive, integrated, and high-quality R&D service platform that covers the entire drug and medical device development lifecycle. It differentiates itself through rich project execution experience, global synchronized operations, advanced digital and AI technologies, specialized therapeutic area expertise, and strong client relationships. Its ability to provide end-to-end solutions, including innovative decentralized clinical trial models and AI-powered services, offers clients faster, more efficient, and higher-quality clinical development support.
